Provenance Groups
An *identity* is a unique cryptographic key pair.
A *party* to a contract is whoever has an identity, and a *person* is a party who established their own identity.
Alice *trusts* Bob when she knows Bob personally and believes him to keep the undertakings he signs under grassroots contracts.
A *message*, a parameter of Groups, is what a person sends. Here: items authored by their senders for messages.
A *relation* is a friendship or the membership of a group. Bob *trusts* Alf, an AI agent of Alice, when he trusts Alice. The *decision rule*, which the principal of an AI agent decides, says who decides for an AI agent and how. An AI agent takes an act of a party by those who decide for the AI agent.
The *author* of an item is its first signer.
The *developer* of an AI agent is the signer of its code.
Alice, Bob and Carol are persons, Alf and Will AI agents.
Knowledge:1. ○ Establish: Alice may establish an identity once. Alice will make herself known by her public key, sign her acts with her private key, and be accountable for every act signed with it.
Knowledge:2. ■ Acquaint: Alice and Bob may jointly come to know each other.
Knowledge:3. ■ Introduce: Alice may introduce Carol to Bob with the consent of Bob, provided Alice and Bob know each other and Alice knows Carol.
Friendship:1. ○ Befriend: Alice and Bob, who trust each other and are not friends, may jointly become friends.
Friendship:2. ■ Unfriend: Alice may end her friendship with Bob.
Friendship:3. ○ Loss of Trust. Alice will end her friendship with Bob if she ceases to trust him.
Groups:1. ■ Message: Alice may send a message to her friend Bob.
Groups:2. ■ Group. Create: Alice may create a group, of which she is the leader and first member. Close: Alice may close the group by leaving it.
Groups:3. ■ Joining and Leaving. Join: Alice, the leader of a group, may add her friend Bob to it, with the consent of Bob. Remove, Leave: Either Alice or Bob may then end Bob's membership in the group, which also ends when Alice and Bob cease to be friends.
Groups:4. ■ Group messaging. Post: A member of a group may send a message to the group. Deliver: Its leader delivers it to every current member.
Guardians:1. ■ Enter: Alice may create an AI agent, Alf, and establish Alf's identity by choosing Alf's key pair. Alice is then the principal, a guardian and a friend of Alf.
Guardians:2. ■ Guardian decisions. Make guardian: Those who decide for Alf may make Bob, a friend of a guardian of Alf, a guardian and a friend of Alf, with the consent of Bob. Resign: Bob may end his guardianship of Alf. End guardian: Those who decide for Alf, other than Bob, may end Bob's guardianship. Guardian unfriend: Bob may end his friendship with Alf, which ends his guardianship. Alf may not end a friendship with her guardian.
Guardians:3. ■ AI agent and person. AI agent acquaint: Alf, an AI agent of Alice, and Bob may jointly come to know each other. AI agent befriend: Alf may enter a relation with Bob with the consent of Bob and Alice, provided Alf and Bob know each other and Alice and Bob are friends. AI agent end, Unfriend, AI agent unfriend: Alf, Bob or Alice may end the relation of Bob and Alf.
Guardians:4. ■ AI agents. AI agents acquaint: Alf, an AI agent of Alice, and Will, an AI agent of Bob, may jointly come to know each other. AI agents befriend: Alf may enter a relation with Will with the consent of Will, Alice and Bob, provided Alf and Will know each other, Alice knows Will and is a friend of Bob, Alice and Bob possibly one person.
Guardians:5. ■ Retire: Those who decide for Alf may retire Alf; every guardianship and relation of Alf then ends and Alf can take no act.
Forwarding:1. ■ Sign: Alice may create an item by signing it.
Forwarding:2. ■ Forward: Alice may forward an item she holds to her friend Bob, adding her signature to the signatures the item carries.
Agents:1. ○ AI developer and guardian accountability. The developer of Alf will be accountable for Alf's defects. Every guardian of Alf will be accountable for operating it recklessly.
Agents:2. ■ AI acts. Enter: The principal of Alf attests at its creation (Guardians:1), signed over Alf's public key, that Alf runs code signed by its developer. Every act of Alf requires this attestation and names its developer and its principal.
Provenance Groups:1. ■ Agent message: An AI agent may send a message to a friend (Groups:1).
Provenance Groups:2. ■ Post forward: A member of a group, not its leader, may forward an item they hold to the group, adding their signature.
